<!-- 2026-09-22 B-motion (audit G M6 / D3a): reduced-motion early return + stop on change; fixed 30 px/s;

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const marquees = document.querySelectorAll('[cl-marquee="list"]');
    if (!marquees.length) return;

    const rm = window.matchMedia ? matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') : null;
    const SPEED_PX_PER_S = 30;      // WDS ambient ticker speed (was contentWidth / cl-marquee-speed ≈ 40 px/s)
    const STATIC_BELOW = 768;       // no marquee on small screens
    const STATIC_ITEM_CAP = 8;      // items shown when static

    function renderStatic(marquee, content, capItems) {
      Array.from(marquee.children).forEach(child => {
        if (child !== content) marquee.removeChild(child);
      });
      marquee.style.transform = '';
      if (!capItems) return;   // testimonials: agent C's snap scroller owns the layout below 768

  .section_card-stack,
  .card-stack_component-wrapper,
  .card-stack_list-wrap,
  .card-stack_list {
    overflow: visible;
  }

  .section_card-stack {
    --card-stack-gap: 8.5rem;
  }

  .card-stack-item_wrap {
    position: sticky;
    top: calc(10rem + (var(--card-index) * var(--card-stack-gap)));
    z-index: var(--card-z);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    will-change: top;
  }

  .card-stack-item_wrap.is-duplicate-buffer {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  .card-stack_title-top,
  .card-stack_title {
    transition: opacity 160ms ease;
  }

  .card-stack_title-top.is-hidden {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  .card-stack_title.is-hide {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  /*
    Only the FIRST card top title uses display:none.
    The fixed min-height prevents the card layout from jumping.
  */
  .card-stack-item_wrap.is-first-card {
    --first-top-title-height: 0px;
  }

  .card-stack-item_wrap.is-first-card .card-stack_title-top {
    min-height: var(--first-top-title-height);
  }

  .card-stack-item_wrap.is-first-card:not(.is-title-active) .card-stack_title-top {
    display: none !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  .card-stack-item_wrap.is-first-card.is-title-active .card-stack_title-top {
    display: flex !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
  }

  .card-stack-item_wrap.is-first-card.is-title-active .card-stack_title:not(.card-stack_title-top) {
    opacity: 0 !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }
</style>

<script>
  window.Webflow = window.Webflow || [];

  window.Webflow.push(() => {
    const section = document.querySelector('.section_card-stack');
    const list = document.querySelector('.card-stack_list');

    if (!section || !list) return;

    const existingBuffer = list.querySelector(
      '.card-stack-item_wrap.is-duplicate-buffer'
    );

    if (!existingBuffer) {
      const originalCardsBeforeDuplicate = [
        ...list.querySelectorAll(
          '.card-stack-item_wrap:not(.is-duplicate-buffer)'
        ),
      ];

      if (originalCardsBeforeDuplicate.length < 2) return;

      const lastRealCard =
        originalCardsBeforeDuplicate[originalCardsBeforeDuplicate.length - 1];

      const duplicateCard = lastRealCard.cloneNode(true);

      duplicateCard.classList.add('is-duplicate-buffer');
      duplicateCard.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

      list.appendChild(duplicateCard);
    }

    /*
      Keep duplicate inside animated cards array.
      This preserves the duplicated-card buffer behavior.
    */
    const cards = [...list.querySelectorAll('.card-stack-item_wrap')];

    if (cards.length < 2) return;

    const realCards = cards.filter((card) => {
      return !card.classList.contains('is-duplicate-buffer');
    });

    if (realCards.length < 2) return;

    const firstRealCard = realCards[0];

    if (firstRealCard) {
      firstRealCard.classList.add('is-first-card');
    }

    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 767;

    const baseTop = 10 * 16;

    // Level 1
    const gapLarge = (isMobile ? 7.5 : 8.5) * 16;

    // Level 2
    const gapMedium = 5 * 16;

    // Level 3
    const gapFinal = 14;

    const earlyTriggerOffset = 4 * 16;
    const titleTriggerOffset = isMobile ? 0 : 2 * 16;

    const lastIndex = cards.length - 1;
    const lastCard = cards[lastIndex];

    let stageOneStart = 0;
    let stageOneEnd = 0;
    let stageTwoStart = 0;
    let stageTwoEnd = 0;

    let ticking = false;
    let lastTitleState = null;

    const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
    const lerp = (start, end, progress) => start + (end - start) * progress;

    cards.forEach((card, index) => {
      card.style.setProperty('--card-index', index);
      card.style.setProperty('--card-z', index + 1);
    });

    function getTopTitles(card) {
      return [...card.querySelectorAll('.card-stack_title-top')];
    }

    function getMainTitles(card) {
      return [...card.querySelectorAll('.card-stack_title')].filter((title) => {
        return !title.classList.contains('card-stack_title-top');
      });
    }

    function setFirstTopTitleHeight() {
      if (!firstRealCard) return;

      const topTitle = firstRealCard.querySelector('.card-stack_title-top');
      if (!topTitle) return;

      const previousDisplay = topTitle.style.display;
      const previousVisibility = topTitle.style.visibility;
      const previousOpacity = topTitle.style.opacity;

      topTitle.style.display = 'flex';
      topTitle.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      topTitle.style.opacity = '0';

      const height = topTitle.offsetHeight;

      firstRealCard.style.setProperty(
        '--first-top-title-height',
        `${height}px`
      );

      topTitle.style.display = previousDisplay;
      topTitle.style.visibility = previousVisibility;
      topTitle.style.opacity = previousOpacity;
    }

    function showTopTitle(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.classList.remove('is-hidden');
    }

    function hideTopTitle(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.classList.add('is-hidden');
    }

    function showMainTitle(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.classList.remove('is-hide');
    }

    function hideMainTitle(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.classList.add('is-hide');
    }

    function setStackedTitleState(showTopTitleState) {
      if (showTopTitleState === lastTitleState) return;

      lastTitleState = showTopTitleState;

      realCards.forEach((card, index) => {
        // Do not change the real last card
        if (index === realCards.length - 1) return;

        const topTitles = getTopTitles(card);
        const mainTitles = getMainTitles(card);

        if (showTopTitleState) {
          card.classList.add('is-title-active');

          topTitles.forEach(showTopTitle);
          mainTitles.forEach(hideMainTitle);
        } else {
          card.classList.remove('is-title-active');

          topTitles.forEach(hideTopTitle);
          mainTitles.forEach(showMainTitle);
        }
      });
    }

    function setGap(value) {
      const safeGap = Math.max(value, gapFinal);
      section.style.setProperty('--card-stack-gap', `${safeGap.toFixed(3)}px`);
    }

    function measure() {
      section.style.setProperty('--card-stack-gap', `${gapLarge}px`);

      setFirstTopTitleHeight();

      lastTitleState = null;
      setStackedTitleState(false);

      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      const lastRect = lastCard.getBoundingClientRect();

      const lastLargeTop = baseTop + lastIndex * gapLarge;

      stageOneStart =
        scrollY + lastRect.top - lastLargeTop - earlyTriggerOffset;

      const stageOneDistance = lastIndex * (gapLarge - gapMedium);
      stageOneEnd = stageOneStart + stageOneDistance;

      stageTwoStart = stageOneEnd;

      const stageTwoDistance = lastIndex * (gapMedium - gapFinal);
      stageTwoEnd = stageTwoStart + stageTwoDistance;

      setGap(gapLarge);
    }

    function calculateGap() {
      const scrollY = window.scrollY;
      let currentGap = gapLarge;

      const shouldShowTopTitle =
        scrollY >= stageTwoStart - titleTriggerOffset;

      setStackedTitleState(shouldShowTopTitle);

      if (scrollY < stageOneStart) {
        currentGap = gapLarge;
      }

      if (scrollY >= stageOneStart && scrollY <= stageOneEnd) {
        const progress = clamp(
          (scrollY - stageOneStart) / (stageOneEnd - stageOneStart),
          0,
          1
        );

        currentGap = lerp(gapLarge, gapMedium, progress);
      }

      if (scrollY > stageOneEnd && scrollY < stageTwoStart) {
        currentGap = gapMedium;
      }

      if (scrollY >= stageTwoStart && scrollY <= stageTwoEnd) {
        const progress = clamp(
          (scrollY - stageTwoStart) / (stageTwoEnd - stageTwoStart),
          0,
          1
        );
